This Appeal Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment
This Appeal is filed by the claimants aggrieved by the dismissal of MVC No.941/2020 dated 14.07.2022, by the I Addl. Senior Civil Judge and MACT Kalaburagi.
The claim petition is filed seeking compensation of an amount of NC: 2024:KHC-K:543 Rs.48,30,780/- for the death of the deceased.
The claimants are the family members of the deceased.

2. It is the case of the claimant that on 06.04.2019 at about 7.15 a.m. the deceased was proceeding on a motorcycle, when he was near Nandini Milk Parlour at that time, the driver of a police Jeep came in a high speed and in rash and negligent manner and dashed the motorcycle on which the deceased was proceeding.
Due to which he fell down and sustained grievous injuries and later succumbed to the injuries.
3. The Court below has observed that a FIR was registered against the deceased as the accident had taken place because of the negligence and thereafter a chargesheet is filed.
Even the brother of the deceased has given a statement before the police that the accident has occurred due to rash and negligent act on the part of the deceased.

The Court below has observed that the claimants have filed Gangotri W/O Shivaraj And Ors vs The Superintendent Of Police And Anr on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132129773/
2 a Criminal Misc.No.210/2019 before NC: 2024:KHC-K:543 the JMFC, Mulbagal wherein the claimants have filed an application under Section 311 of Cr.P.C. for re-opening the case and adducing the evidence.

entities.text: Gangotri W/O Shivaraj And Ors vs The Superintendent Of Police And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Court observed that the claimants have not filed any documents and accordingly had dismissed the claim petition.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the claimants submits that the brother of deceased is not an eye witness to the incident.
PW2 is an eye witness according to whom in front of his hotel, the accident had taken place.

The Court has failed to discuss the evidence of PW2 in the entire order and also taken an adverse inference that the claimants have not filed any document to show what has happened before the Criminal Court.
It is submitted that the Court below without appreciating the evidence of the eye witness had dismissed the claim petition.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel appearing for the respondents submits that when final report is filed, they have a remedy before the Criminal Court, which they have failed to avail.
Though it is stated that they have NC: 2024:KHC-K:543 availed, no orders were placed before the Court and the deceased himself was at fault.
The Court below had rightly dismissed the claim petition and no grounds are made out to interfere with the well considered order passed by the Court below.
6. Having heard the learned counsels on either sides, perused the entire material on record.

7. In this case, according to PW2 i.e. eye witness, deceased regularly comes to his hotel and that day also he came to the hotel and when he was going on the left side of the road suddenly the driver of the police jeep drove it in a rash and negligent manner and hit the motorcycle and because of it he fell down and sustained injuries.
The said evidence of PW2 is crucial to the case.
Unfortunately there is no whisper in the entire order passed by the Court below about the evidence of PW2 and why it was not considered.
The Court below is impressed more on the final report filed against the deceased.

The Court failed to appreciate the fact that the vehicle involved in the NC:
2024:KHC-K:543 accident is the police jeep.
The Court should have given more importance to the evidence of PW2, then to the final report filed by them.
It appears from the order that already a petition is filed by the wife of the deceased before the Court below.

8. Considering that this is a case of death and further the evidence is not properly appreciated by the Court below, the order impugned is set aside and the matter is remanded back to the Court below for fresh consideration.

9. The Court below shall give an opportunity to both the parties to adduce evidence if any and shall consider the evidence on record in a proper perspective and decide the case and pass appropriate orders.
10. Accordingly, the appeal is allowed by setting aside the award dated 14.07.2022.
